name: nix-knowledge
summary: Bounded on-demand organizational knowledge discovery and reviewed contribution for LNX/default only.
rationale: Keep canonical company truth in the owning knowledgebase and preserve native Hermes continuity and working skills without broad profile assignment.
license: MIT for original documentation inside skills/nix-knowledge only; exact scoped notice preserved.
risks: Instructions are not a filesystem or credential sandbox; existing task and access authority remains mandatory.
Source links do not establish current KB note validity or private repository access.
No live activation, new Discord session, or representative renderer acceptance has occurred.
Preservation of changed working skills and generated watch-cache handling requires separately authenticated exact-proposal approval.
Ordinary NixKit GitHub sources retain first-fetch integrity; future rollout must independently compare acquired bytes against the pinned source.

gate_evidence.relevance: LNX/default orchestrates Nix portfolio work and needs bounded on-demand discovery of the canonical organizational knowledgebase rather than copying truth into native continuity.
gate_evidence.provenance: Original its-nix/os documentation at 1182c51c33ccb8a6c3b095bf551864fc5cb061c6, exact skills/nix-knowledge path. Real NixKit acquisition retained all three package files and independent Git-object comparison established bytes and full closure.
gate_evidence.reliability: Reviewed documentation-only source, explicit retrieval/contribution contract and local reference closure; NixKit subset acquisition and offline repeat exercised in scratch. No claim of fresh Discord retrieval or knowledge correctness.
gate_evidence.safety_privacy: No executable payload, dependency, hook, automatic ingestion or install instruction. Explicit task/access authority, provisional/disputed status, no credential or profile mutation authority; actual host skills-guard-v10 community scan safe and allowed, not a sandbox.
gate_evidence.license: Complete package-scoped MIT notice at skills/nix-knowledge/LICENSE at 1182c51c33ccb8a6c3b095bf551864fc5cb061c6; retained byte-for-byte. Does not license the whole OS or linked third-party material.
gate_evidence.hermes_compatibility: Standard on-demand SKILL.md frontmatter, relative reference exists; real scratch Hermes detached acquisition and native static community scanner passed. Fresh-session behavior remains a later acceptance gate.
gate_evidence.non_duplication: Default enabled inventory audit found 84 distinct names and neither candidate. Native memory/session skills provide personal continuity, not bounded canonical Nix KB discovery and owner-reviewed contribution; no duplicate organizational entry skill found.
